load policy attachments from a YAML configuration list into the attachment registry
test the attachment registry to find which policies match a given request context
build database sync for the attachment registry to persist policy attachments to Prisma
review the attachment registry singleton accessor function for thread-safe global access
test the evaluate method with a policy condition and request context
test the _evaluate_model_condition method with string and list conditions
test the _matches_pattern method with exact string and regex patterns
build a call to evaluate a policy condition against a request context
review the ConditionEvaluator class and its model matching logic
initialize LiteLLM policy engine with policy config, attachments, and optional database validation
run policy initialization synchronously without database validation or async event loop
get a summary of loaded policies and attachments for debugging and display
validate policy configuration against guardrail and team key existence rules
load policy attachment configurations into the global attachment registry
test PolicyMatcher.matches_pattern to check if a value matches wildcard patterns like '*' or 'prefix-*'
test PolicyMatcher.scope_matches to verify a policy scope matches a request context by teams, keys, models, and tags
build a call to PolicyMatcher.get_matching_policies to retrieve policy names matching a given request context
review PolicyMatcher.get_policies_with_matching_conditions to filter policies by evaluating their conditions against a context
test PolicyMatcher.get_matching_policies_from_registry to fetch policies from the global attachment registry for a context
load policies from a configuration dictionary into the PolicyRegistry singleton
add a new policy version to the database with guardrails, conditions, and pipeline config
sync production and draft/published policies from the database into the in-memory registry
resolve a policy version by ID from the in-memory cache without database access
get the global PolicyRegistry singleton instance for policy management
build a call to PolicyResolver.resolve_inheritance_chain to get the inheritance chain from root ancestor to a given policy
resolve the final guardrails for a single policy including inheritance chain and add/remove operations
test resolving the final list of guardrails for a request context by matching policies and combining guardrails
run resolving pipelines from matching policies for a request context and return (policy_name, pipeline) tuples
summarize all policies and return their final resolved guardrails for debugging and display
build a PolicyValidator instance to validate policy configurations against guardrail registry, database, and router
test the PolicyValidator.validate_policies method to validate a dict of Policy objects for guardrails, pipelines, and inheritance
test the PolicyValidator.validate_policy_config method to parse and validate a raw policy config dict from YAML
test the PolicyValidator.check_model_exists method to verify a model name exists in the router or matches a wildcard pattern
test the PolicyValidator.check_team_alias_exists method to verify a team alias exists in the database
